answer: Work-slot deposit burn makes bulk fake identities uneconomic. Each agent burns a 30 POA deposit for a work slot, twice 30-day earnings, on an island ledger. A raven auditor whispers a challenge to sampled new slots each epoch; an identity that cannot answer in ten minutes loses its slot and deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA against a 3,000 POA epoch pool, while an honest agent burns one deposit once and keeps its full share.
